output.evaluation_rationale: PRO-SUP-01 achieved the highest overall score because it attained the maximum possible points on the two most heavily weighted criteria—cost (100) and delivery (100). The second‑ranked supplier, PRO-SUP-02, saved on cost (82.58) but maintained perfect delivery and strong risk, contract, and capability scores, yielding a respectable 90.4.
